classification: Read-only selected health observations, independently validated on the existing synthetic 400-tick original combat fixture

native_getter_evidence.availability: Original getter requires actor flag bit2, signed component count at least3 and nonnull slot2. Flag-clear does not mean storage is absent. Present HP0 remains distinct from unavailable health.

limits: Only three constructor-proven actor classes are interpreted; unknown classes remain unknown. Max HP, shield and tower activation are not inferred.
Separate original leaf calls use copied selected fields with exact read guards; this is not a full engine snapshot or independent Android oracle.
Zero-HP states are transient observations after the original clamp, not returned-frame samples.
Memory/register equality covers mapped guest bytes and87 named registers, not opaque CPU/VM or host state. The fixture retains its synthetic arena/context and platform limits.
